THE ESSENTIALS

The Mercury Advantage

Mercury is a financial technology platform that provides banking services for US companies. It has become the gold standard for global entrepreneurs and non-US residents because it allows completely remote account opening and has zero monthly fees.

However, because of strict US anti-money laundering (AML) and KYC regulations, Mercury's compliance teams are incredibly strict. A simple discrepancy in your application, an unclear business model, or an unprofessional website will result in an immediate and irreversible rejection.

Why Mercury?

  • **Remote Opening:** No US travel or US visa required.
  • **Zero Fees:** No monthly minimums, maintenance fees, or overdraft charges.
  • **API & Cards:** Virtual/physical debit cards and powerful software integrations.
THE RISK

The Danger of Winging It

Mercury doesn't offer second chances. If your application fails their risk assessment, you will not get an account.

Permanent Bans

Mercury rarely accepts appeals. If you are rejected due to a poorly explained business model, your LLC and personal identity will be blacklisted from their platform indefinitely.

Website Red Flags

Applying with a template website, missing Terms & Conditions, placeholder text, or an unclear value proposition signals high risk and fraud to compliance officers.

Document Discrepancies

If the address on your utility bill doesn't exactly match your passport or your application inputs, the automated KYC systems will auto-reject your file.

ALTERNATIVES

Other Banking Options

If Mercury isn't a fit for your specific business model, we also guide on alternatives.

Relay Financial

An excellent alternative to Mercury with multi-account support and strong integration with accounting platforms. Great for e-commerce.

Wise Business

The best option for receiving international currencies and managing FX conversions with transparent, mid-market rates.

Payoneer

A solid backup option for freelancers and Amazon sellers needing a US receiving account quickly, though with higher fees.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Mercury is a financial technology company (not a bank itself) that provides banking services backed by Choice Financial Group and Evolve Bank & Trust. It is the premier choice for tech startups and US LLCs owned by non-US residents due to its lack of monthly fees, remote account opening, and modern API.

Yes. Mercury explicitly supports US companies (like a Wyoming LLC) owned entirely by non-US residents, provided the business meets their compliance standards and is not engaged in prohibited industries or located in sanctioned countries.

You need your LLC's Articles of Organization, the IRS CP-575 EIN confirmation letter, a valid passport for the owner(s), a utility bill or bank statement for proof of address, and a documented online presence (like a professional website or Upwork profile).

Rejections typically happen because the business model is unclear, the website looks like a template/scam, the industry is unsupported (e.g., adult, crypto, gambling), or the founder's identity/address verification failed. Poorly formatted applications are flagged instantly by their compliance AI.

No one can guarantee account approval, as the final decision rests strictly with Mercury's compliance and banking partners. However, our guidance drastically increases your approval odds by ensuring your application is structured exactly how their compliance teams want to see it.

It is extremely difficult to overturn a rejection. If you've been rejected, we can evaluate why it happened. In some cases, we can help you apply to alternative digital banks (like Relay or Wise) instead, as Mercury rarely allows appeals.

While you don't strictly need a US IP, using a VPN can sometimes flag the application as suspicious. Mercury prefers you apply from your actual location. A US phone number is helpful but generally not a strict blocking requirement.

We review your business model, verify your LLC documents, audit your website for trust signals, and walk you through exactly what to write in the Mercury application form regarding your business activities and expected transaction volumes.

No. Mercury does not have minimum balance requirements, monthly account fees, or hidden overdraft fees. It is ideal for bootstrapped startups and freelancers.

If your application is clean and well-prepared, approval can take anywhere from 1 to 5 business days. Complex businesses may require additional manual review.

Yes, Mercury provides a routing number and account number capable of receiving domestic ACH, domestic wires, and international SWIFT wires in USD.
